shortDescription: Australia’s consumer confidence fell back toward deeply pessimistic territory in September as households worried the Reserve Bank of Australia may resume raising interest rates and as fuel costs rose, according to Bloomberg.

title: Australia Consumer Confidence Falls on Rate-Hike Fears, Fuel Costs
